Return exactly the supplied JSON schema with all 17 original hypothesis keys. For each emit choice, spans, reason, used_skill_ids in that order. The common schema describes permitted values, not answers about this contract. {"full_contract_with_original_span_markers":"<SPAN 0>NON – DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT</SPAN 0>
<SPAN 1> </SPAN 1><SPAN 2>This agreement made this __________ day of ___________ , 20__, by and between:______________________, (“Writer”), and __________________ (“Producer’), .</SPAN 2>
<SPAN 3>Whereas, Writer has written a script (“Submission”) for a possible future theatrical or motion picture production.</SPAN 3>
<SPAN 4> </SPAN 4><SPAN 5>Whereas, Writer wishes Producer to evaluate said “Submission” for the sole purpose of determining whether said Submission may be further developed into a motion picture (“Project”).</SPAN 5>
<SPAN 6>NOW, THEREAFTER, in consideration of the premises and mutual covenants herein contained, the parties agree as follows:</SPAN 6>
<SPAN 7>1. 1. </SPAN 7><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-definition-form-identification-evidence":[0,1]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 8>All information disclosed by Writer to Producer, in writing, whether or not such information is also disclosed orally, that relates or refers, directly or indirectly, to the Submission, including the Submission itself, shall be deemed confidential and shall constitute Confidential Information, and shall include </SPAN 8><SPAN 9>(i) all documents generated by Producer which contain, comment upon, or relate in any way to any Confidential Information received form Writer, and </SPAN 9><SPAN 10>(ii) any written samples of the Submission received from Writer together with any information derived by Producer there from. </SPAN 10><SPAN 11>.2. Confidential Information shall not include any information:</SPAN 11>
<SPAN 12> </SPAN 12><SPAN 13>.</SPAN 13><SPAN 14>(i) That Producer can show by documentary evidence was known to Producer or prior to the date of its disclosure to Producer by Writer or</SPAN 14>
<SPAN 15> </SPAN 15><SPAN 16>.</SPAN 16><SPAN 17>(ii) That becomes publicly known, by publication or otherwise, not due to any unauthorized act or omission of Producer or any other party having an obligation of confidentiality to Writer; or,</SPAN 17>
<SPAN 18> </SPAN 18><SPAN 19>.</SPAN 19><SPAN 20>(iii) That is subsequently disclos3ed by Writer to any person, firm or corporation on a on-confidential basis; or</SPAN 20>
<SPAN 21> </SPAN 21><SPAN 22>.</SPAN 22><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-exception-source-development-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 23>(iv) That producer can conclusively show by documentary evidence that such information was developed independent of any access to the Confidential Information.</SPAN 23>
<SPAN 24>2. 3. </SPAN 24><SPAN 25>Writer will disclose the Confidential Information to Producer solely for the purpose of allowing Producer to evaluate the Submission to determine, in its sole discretion, whether the Submission may be further developed into a Project.</SPAN 25>
<SPAN 26>3. 4. </SPAN 26><SPAN 27>Producer agrees to accept disclosure of the Confidential Information and to exercise the same degree of care to maintain the Confidential Information secret and confidential as is employed by Producer to preserve and safeguard its own materials and confidential information.</SPAN 27>
<SPAN 28>4. 5. </SPAN 28><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-authorized-recipient-evidence":[2],"nda-rights-license-purpose-evidence":[2]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 29>The Confidential Information shall remain the property of Writer and shall not be disclosed or revealed by Producer or anyone else except employees of Producer who have a need to know the information in connection with Producer’s evaluation of the Submission, and who have entered into a secrecy agreement with Producer under which such employees are required to keep confidential the Confidential Information of Writer, and such employees shall be advised by Producer of the confidential nature of the information and that the information shall be treated accordingly. </SPAN 29><SPAN 30>Producer shall be liable for any improper disclosure of the Confidential Information by its employees.</SPAN 30>
<SPAN 31> </SPAN 31><SPAN 32>.6. </SPAN 32><SPAN 33>(i) Producer shall notify Writer of any determination it may arrive at with respect to the further development of the submission, provided, however, that, in doing so, Producer shall not directly or indirectly disclose any Confidential Information to any third party, without the consent of Writer. </SPAN 33><SPAN 34>.</SPAN 34><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-return-copy-retention-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 35>(ii) If Producer determines that the Submission cannot be further developed into a Project, within <….> months of the receipt of the Submission, Producer shall within five (5) business days after such determination return any and all Confidential Information to Writer, along with all copies or derivatives thereof and all writings generated by Producer in connection with Producer’s evaluation of the Submission or the Confidential Information.</SPAN 35>
<SPAN 36>5. 7. </SPAN 36><SPAN 37>If Producer determines that the Submission is suitable for further development into a Project, Producer and Writer will attempt to agree on a schedule for development, and compensation to Writer for the submission.</SPAN 37>
<SPAN 38>6. 8. </SPAN 38><SPAN 39>Other than as specifically provided herein, Producer will not use the Confidential Information for any purpose whatsoever other than for the sole purpose permitted in paragraph 3 hereof, unless and until a further executed agreement is first made between the parties setting forth the terms and conditions under which rights to the Submission and the Confidential Information are to be licensed to, or acquired by, Producer.</SPAN 39>
<SPAN 40>7. 9. </SPAN 40><SPAN 41>Writer agrees that it will not contact any party or parties other than Producer concerning the Confidential Information without prior written authorization from Producer during the term of this agreement.</SPAN 41>
<SPAN 42> </SPAN 42><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-survival-continuity-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 43>.10. Producer’s obligations under paragraphs 3,4, and 8 of this agreement shall extend from the date of this agreement and shall survive the expiration or termination of this agreement, provided, however, that Producer’s obligations under paragraphs 3 and 4 of this agreement shall terminate immediately in the event that Writer .shall purposefully disclose the Confidential Information to any other person, firm, or corporation on a non-confidential basis, during the term of this Agreement.</SPAN 43>
<SPAN 44>8. 11. </SPAN 44><SPAN 45>Writer hereby expressly warrants that it has the full right and authority to disclose the Confidential Information to Producer, and that no prior public non-confidential disclosure of the Confidential Information ahs been made by Writer nor, to the best of Writer’s knowledge, by any other party.</SPAN 45>
<SPAN 46>9. 12. </SPAN 46><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-definition-form-identification-evidence":[0],"nda-rights-license-purpose-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 47>Nothing in this agreement shall be deemed a sale or offer for sale of the Submission, and nothing contained herein shall in any way obligate Writer to grant to Producer a license or any other rights, directly or by implication, estoppel or otherwise to the Confidential Information or the Submission.</SPAN 47>
<SPAN 48>10. 13. </SPAN 48><SPAN 49>Subject to paragraph 10 above, this agreement shall terminate ________ years from the date of this agreement, unless extended by mutual agreement of the parties. </SPAN 49><SPAN 50>This agreement may be terminated prior to the expiration of __________ from the date this agreement by either Writer or Producer upon thirty (30) days’ written notice to the other parties of an intention to terminate.</SPAN 50>
<SPAN 51>11. 14. </SPAN 51><SPAN 52>This agreement sets forth the entire agreement between the parties and may not be amended or modified except by a writing signed by all of the parties.</SPAN 52>
<SPAN 53>12. 15. </SPAN 53><SPAN 54>This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.</SPAN 54>
<SPAN 55>13. 16. </SPAN 55><SPAN 56>This agreement may be executed in counterparts.</SPAN 56>
<SPAN 57>IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this agreement as of the day and year first above written.</SPAN 57>
<SPAN 58>WRITER PRODUCER</SPAN 58>
<SPAN 59>By: By:</SPAN 59>
<SPAN 60>Name: Name:</SPAN 60>
<SPAN 61>Title:</SPAN 61>
<SPAN 62>Date: Date:</SPAN 62>
